title: Crystal structure determination of 4f–5f heterometallic complexes

synthesis.procedure: Addition of lanthanum triflate to a mixture of [HNC5H5]2[UO2Cl4] and tBu-calix[6]arene (H6L) in pyridine at room temperature immediately changed the pale yellow solution to deep red. Standing for 30 days afforded red crystals of 1 among other products. Repeating the synthesis of 1 under diluted NMR-tube conditions (0.005 g H6L in 10 mL pyridine, one equivalent of [HNC5H5]2[UO2Cl4] and two equivalents of [La(O3SCF3)3], room temperature) also produced crystals of 1 together with 2 and unreacted starting materials after 180 days. The complexes were too unstable for isolation in elementally pure form.

synthesis.procedure: The synthesis of 1 was repeated under diluted conditions to grow crystals from otherwise insoluble products. An NMR tube was charged with 0.005 g of H6L in pyridine (10 mL); one equivalent of [HNC5H5]2[UO2Cl4] and two equivalents of [La(O3SCF3)3] were added. After standing at room temperature for 180 days, colourless crystals of 2 suitable for X-ray crystallography were isolated among crystals of 1 and unreacted starting materials. The cluster salt crystallizes as [H(NC5H5)2]2[HNC5H5]2[2]·3(NC5H5).
